author: XBOX
description:
Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG set in Weavereach, a shattered world where the gods have perished and the Gyldenmist sweeps the realm. 

As a Gyldhunter, venture into the heart of the corruption solo or with up to two companions, defeating twisted creatures for their spoils or hunting rival Gyldhunters for their loot. Just be careful: if you die, you lose everything. 

To secure a safe return to the Windrest, Gyldhunters must track down extraction opportunities hidden within the realm and ring the bell known as Soul of Return to escape. However, the Gyldenmist may conceal more than one way out.

Heading to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC, Mistfall Hunter will arrive as a Day One release with XBOX Game Pass at 6:00 PM PT on July 29, 2026. A 10% launch discount on the Standard and Deluxe Editions is available across all platforms until August 12.
